text:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — Zellex POC hitting 401 on hosted inference calls, message is `invalid_api_key` even though they say header is present. Root call ts 1718504321. Anyone seen this recently?
Maria Gomez: Can you paste the exact curl + headers? Also which key type did they create (trial/org/project/service)?
Alex Chen: Here's the sample they sent (redacted):
```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_test_ABC' -H 'X-Client-Org: org-zellex' -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
They added `X-Client-Org` but still 401.
Samira Patel: If the error is `invalid_api_key` often it's key not found or bound to a different org. Ask them to check Account > API keys — make sure it's an org-level key not personal.
Alex Chen: They say key was created by a contractor under account `zellex-sales`. How do we confirm binding server-side?
Jon P: Check auth logs. @InfraBot can you pull recent auth logs for `sk_test_ABC`?
InfraBot: Auth logs pulled: 2024-06-05T15:21Z — sk_test_ABC — key exists, bound_org: org-zellex-sales, request_org_header: org-zellex -> result: 401 invalid_org_binding
Maria Gomez: Ah yep — mismatch: `org-zellex-sales` vs `org-zellex`. If the request header is `org-zellex` our auth layer rejects it. Two options: (1) reissue a key scoped to `org-zellex` or (2) have them set the header to `org-zellex-sales`.
Alex Chen: Client is using a third-party SDK and changing header is non-trivial for them. Can we rebind the key or issue a new org-level key quickly?
Samira Patel: Sales can request a temporary org key. I'll create a POC org key and DM the secure value. Also note they retried heavily and we saw 429s in the logs — they retried ~10x after 401s.
Alex Chen: :grimacing: they also exhausted free trial credits during retries. Any option for extra POC volume/pricing?
Maria Gomez: We can grant a one-week POC uplift (100k tokens) at a discounted rate. I'll prepare a presales uplift/credit and send to billing. @Samira please create a support ticket with billing artifacts and the new key details.
Samira Patel: Created ticket #SUP-3921 and generated a new org-scoped key. Sent via 1:1 to Alex. Key prefix (redacted): `sk_poc_ZELLEX_...`
Alex Chen: Deployed new key into their test env — running test call now... got 200 OK! Thank you all. Quick follow-up: their embedding calls are sometimes returning `invalid_scope`.
Jon P: `invalid_scope` suggests the key is missing the `embed` scope. Keys have scopes like `[generate, embed, rerank]`. Samira, did you enable `embed` on the POC key?
Samira Patel: I enabled generate+embed. Could be they're calling `v1/embeddings` with old model name `embed-old`. Ask them to use `rwd-embed-v2` or the model we recommended.
Alex Chen: Forwarded that. Summary for the thread: root cause was org-binding mismatch + heavy retries causing 429s and trial exhaustion. We issued a new org-scoped POC key and uplifted trial credits. Will close after billing confirms.
Maria Gomez: :thumbsup: Nice triage. Checklist for closing: confirm key scopes, confirm header matches bound org, confirm billing uplift applied. Ping here when done and we'll mark resolved.
